title: Link Preview
summary: A link checker fetches pages from its own server. It blocks internal addresses, or the ones it thought of.
objectives: Get the server to request an address of your choosing
Walk the metadata service and recover the preview service's secret key
learningOutcomes: Explain why denylists of host names fail
Defend with allowlists, resolved-address checks, network egress rules and token-protected metadata

references.label: OWASP Top 10 A10:2021 Server-Side Request Forgery

hints.bodyMd: The metadata service answers at `http://metadata:8080/`. The filter compares the host name as written, not the address it resolves to.
DNS treats `metadata` and `metadata.` (with a trailing dot) as the same name. Once you're in, list each directory, starting with `/latest/meta-data/`.
